text: I'm looking after my nephew tonight and I'm really scared I'm going to get this wrong. He's 6 months old, temp is 37.9. He's come out in a red rash on his chest and back. I did the glass thing and it goes pale when I press it, which I read is the better sign, but I'm still panicking. How much Calpol or ibuprofen can I give a 6 month old? I don't want to give him too much. His mum's away till tomorrow.
